assertions.name: alld0_cosh_gives_identical_mirror
assertions.source: all-d-zeroed χ_λ(³H) == χ_λ(³He) → cosh asymmetry is an artifact

data.description: Diagnosis of the 5.9% cosh mirror-asymmetry in the ³H/³He q-Reeb split: per-λ character mismatch under full / inter-zeroed / all-d-zeroed. all-d-zeroed → ³H ≡ ³He proves the asymmetry is an artifact of incomplete sinh-removal; the entire split is bar-odd (sinh). Audit-only; no fit.
data.verdict: The proton(uud)−neutron(udd) intra-nucleon d-difference is exactly +h (bar-odd/sinh). strong_channel_rho zeros only inter-nucleon d (k%3==2), leaving the intra-nucleon bar-odd term in the 'cosh' bucket → the 5.9% asymmetry. The TRUE all-d-zeroed cosh channel gives ³H ≡ ³He (max|Δχ_λ| = 0.0e+00), so the cosh contributes ZERO to the split: the entire ³H/³He split is bar-odd (sinh), per the cheat-sheet n−p rule. The residual is therefore a clean ~18% overshoot of the all-sinh q-Reeb phase at universal ρ, NOT a cosh/sinh mixing. No fit; no rewire.
